- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:Lines 1300-1380 (_evaluate_bash, the for loop over invocations) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Pushes to non-origin repositories or pushes redirected by per-command Git configuration are not marked for confirmation, so the guard checks origin PR history instead of verifying the actual push destination.
  WHY: The guard can silently proceed with a credential-exposed push to a different repository while relying on origin's PR history.

  WHY: These forms can regress without this test detecting incorrect destination handling; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rated this MAJOR and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it NIT.
